Record test data and provide structured feedback to the design team.

Single Sign-On (SSO)
across multiple applications.

Manage user authentication and authorization
Implement

across enterprise apps

SAML 2.0 SSO
OAuth 2.0 flows
OpenID Connect (OIDC)

Just-In-Time (JIT) provisioning
User federation IDs

Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
IP restrictions and login policies
Ensure compliance with enterprise security standards

Diagnose login/SSO issues
Analyze authentication logs and debug failures
Maintain uptime and reliability of identity services

Document SSO configurations and flows
Work with security teams, DevOps, and application owners

Profiles, Permission Sets

Tools & Platforms

Okta

Administrator

Knowledge of Zero Trust security concepts

EMC/EMI testing.

Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams (software, mechanical, systems, manufacturing).
Drive technical decision-making and deliver high-quality documentation.
Cross-functional Collaboration
Work with suppliers for component selection, sourcing, and cost optimization.
Coordinate with manufacturing and quality teams for product industrialization.
Support customer discussions, requirement clarifications, and design feasibility assessments.
